Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)

Having eyes in the back of your head isn’t limited to mothers anymore — assuming you’re okay with a cybereye in the back of your brain.

External Body Cyberware. Allows for the installation of a Cybereye on the back of the user’s head. Cybereye is sold and installed separately. User can only have one Rear Optical Mount installed. Can be concealed by clothing or Techhair.

NOTE: Based on what Jimmy Kurosaki has in Edgerunners.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 1

Foundry notes:

  • It has 1 slot for the Cybereye, but the sheet only offers install targets that match the item's own cyberware type, so drag the Cybereye onto this item's sheet or track it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
